description: Crew event on a train parted by a broken coupler (eu07/maszyna#510, review of #422): an EN57-2000 unit with an AI driver and no timetable stands on track 1 of Stacja1 on td.scn, and another one with nobody in it runs into its rear at 100 km/h. The hit breaks the coupler between the middle and the rear car of the standing unit (TMoverParameters::damage_coupler()), which parts the unit and leaves the rear car with the driver in charge of it, as uncoupling doesn't. At 10:35 a putvalues event, Crew:<vehicle> 0 0, takes the driver off: all three vehicles of the unit had it in charge, the parted ones too, and none of them keeps it.

trainsets: node -1 0 {{vehicle}} dynamic pkp\en57-2000_v1 en57-2040_ra 6ba 0 headdriver 255 0 enddynamic
node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_s dynamic pkp\en57-2000_v1 en57-2040_s 6bs 0 nobody 255 0 enddynamic
node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_rb dynamic pkp\en57-2000_v1 en57-2040_rb 6bb 0 nobody 0 0 enddynamic
node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_hit_ra dynamic pkp\en57-2000_v1 en57-2040_ra 6ba 0 nobody 255 0 enddynamic
node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_hit_s dynamic pkp\en57-2000_v1 en57-2040_s 6bs 0 nobody 255 0 enddynamic
node -1 0 {{vehicle}}_hit_rb dynamic pkp\en57-2000_v1 en57-2040_rb 6bb 0 nobody 0 0 enddynamic

node -1 0 autotest_crew_off_launcher eventlauncher 0 0 0 -1 none 1035 autotest_crew_off end
